newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber ends mixed, nearbys down on slow cash.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber ends mixed, nearbys down on slow cash.

text.p: Reports of slow cash trade wighed on nearby CME lumber futures while back months finished higher in thin dealings, traders said.
Lumber closed $3.90 lower to $2.00 higher, with May off most at $381.60 per tbf and July $1.40 lower at $378.80.

Futures drifted down as reports again circulated that 2X4 business was again slow compared to wider widths. Cash prices for 2X4 spruce have risen the past couple of weeks but so has futures and it is turning hard to push futures much higher is demand for product is running at lighter than expected levels, traders said.
Refco sold on the early break and ING bought on the scale down later against light general selling, they said.
